name: Deiphobus
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 1867 Deiphobus: diameter 118.22 ± 1.616 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[jupiter_trojans] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759...49G)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 118.22 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Deiphobus. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: Deiphobus was found at El Leoncito on 3 March 1971.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 118.22 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
